batch: Phase 3 batch (a): JRN-62..68 + JRN-70 + Q-27 (8 criteria)

notes.detail: After posting, the success panel says 'Print / download receipt'. The journey says 'Print / share receipt'. The print action is there, but the word 'share' is missing.

Customer 360 More menu has Edit customer, Co-applicants and Statements, plus extra items: New booking, Generate document, Add note, New ticket, Schedule visit. This matches action_inventory (C1/C4/C6), but it is a longer list than the 3 items the criterion names.

On one early run, the Customer 360 Activity tab text (main.innerText) ended with a bare UUID '339d6c4e-ea55-4f63-b4cf-1b9578080796' (admin user id) after 'No notes yet.'. A later scan of the same tab, after waiting for the timeline, was clean. Not reproduced, so not filed as a bug. Worth a look: an element that can show a raw user id.
'Demand Draft' (DD, the payment mode) shows in Bills & Receipts, Ledger and the Customer Money tab. It is a real banking instrument name, not the internal 'demand' word, so the scan allows it.

On the story:cancel booking, the ledger law holds (46,988 - 46,988 = 0 - 0). The API summary still shows other_udhar_paise 9,397,600 with other_received 0, and this is not in total_bill_raised. It is probably other charges waived on cancel, but this was not confirmed.
The ledger of BK-2526-2331 has a leftover row 'Reversal · TEST_ qa reversal' (KKT/2627/26974) from an earlier tester's run. It is net zero, but the purge may not recognise the name.
